subject: design/implement-now-issue-entry
statement: Store canonical admitted native task bytes and bounded origin metadata through `internal/gitrefstore`, using a dedicated implement-now issue evidence ref and digest-addressed paths. Reuse its fetch, exact-read, CAS, and idempotent-update mechanics; do not add a database or a general amendment engine.
